messages.snippet: Dear Colleague, The TCC Practitioners Forum invites you to our spring seminar on the enforceability
messages.subject: Spring seminar: Limitation clauses after recent UCTA decisions
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Colleague,

The TCC Practitioners Forum invites you to our spring seminar on the enforceability of limitation and exclusion clauses in construction and supply contracts following recent appellate decisions on the Unfair Contract Terms Act 1977. 3 CPD hours.

Date: 19 March, 17:30, Inner Temple. To register, reply to this email.

Kind regards,
The TCC Practitioners Forum
